 FIRST ALERT: Halloween sprinkles, eyeing Election Day washout 
 By Ethan Zarek Published : Oct. 31, 2026 at 4:17 PM EDT | Updated : 2 hours ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google MARQUETTE, Mich. (WLUC) - You may have to dodge a few small showers while out on Halloween-related festivities.
 After the clocks fall back, Sunday is quieter with mostly cloudy skies. Sunny start to Monday gets spoiled quickly with widespread rain entering during the early afternoon. Moderate to heavy downpours could be possible at times. Monday’s rain extends through Election Day and into Wednesday morning. An inch or more of rain looks likely for most of the U.P.
 The rest of the week into next weekend looks to be drier and cooler. Temperatures closer to average.
 Sunday: Mostly cloudy
 >Highs: Mid 50s - lower 60s
 Monday: PM rain, mostly cloudy
 >Highs: Mid 50s - lower 60s
 Election Day: Rounds of rain
 >Highs: Mid 50s - lower 60s
 Wednesday: AM rain
 >Highs: Upper 40s - mid 50s
 Thursday: Partly cloudy
 >Highs: Upper 40s - mid 50s
 Friday: Partly cloudy
 >Highs: Upper 40s - mid 50s
 Saturday: Partly cloudy, showers east
 >Highs: 40s
